en.t: 680 g russet potatoes, peeled and sliced 0.5 cm thick
Salt and pepper
8 tbsp (115 g) unsalted butter, cut into 8 pieces
1 small onion, chopped
1/2 small head savoy cabbage, cored and cut into 2.5 cm pieces (1180 ml)

1. Place potatoes and 1 tbsp (15 ml) salt in medium saucepan and cover with water by 2.5 cm. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until tip of paring knife inserted into potatoes meets no resistance, 8 to 10 minutes.
2. Drain potatoes and return them to saucepan. Add 3 tbsp (42 g) butter and ¼ tsp (1.2 g) pepper. Using potato masher, mash until smooth. Set aside.

3. Melt 1 tbsp (15 ml) butter in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Stir in cabbage, 2 tbsp (30 ml) water, and ½ tsp (2.5 ml) salt. Cover and cook until cabbage is wilted and lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer cabbage mixture to saucepan with potato mixture and stir to combine. Wipe skillet clean with paper towels.

4. Melt 2 tbsp (28 g) butter in now-empty skillet over medium-high heat. Add potato-cabbage mixture to skillet and, using rubber spatula, press into even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until bottom is well browned, about 7 minutes.

5. Flip spatula-size portions of potato mixture and lightly repack in skillet. Break remaining 2 tbsp (28 g) butter into small pieces and distribute around edge of skillet. Repeat flipping process every few minutes until potato-cabbage mixture is evenly browned, 8 to 10 minutes longer. Serve.

4. Melt 1⅓ tbsp (20 g) butter in now-empty skillet over medium-high heat. Add potato-cabbage mixture to skillet and, using rubber spatula, press into even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until bottom is well browned, about 7 minutes.

5. Flip spatula-size portions of potato mixture and lightly repack in skillet. Break remaining 1⅓ tbsp (20 g) butter into small pieces and distribute around edge of skillet. Repeat flipping process every few minutes until potato-cabbage mixture is evenly browned, 8 to 10 minutes longer. Serve.

1. Zemiaky a 1 PL (15 ml) soli dáme do stredného kastróla a zalejeme vodou tak, aby boli 2,5 cm pod hladinou. Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme na stredný a varíme, kým špička malého noža vpichnutá do zemiakov nenarazí na žiadny odpor, 8 až 10 minút.
2. Zemiaky scedíme a vrátime do kastróla. Pridáme 2 PL (29 g) masla a ¼ ČL (1,2 g) korenia. Štuchadlom na zemiaky roztlačíme dohladka. Odložíme.

3. V nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom 30 cm rozpustíme na strednom ohni 2 ČL (10 ml) masla. Pridáme cibuľu a dusíme, kým nezmäkne, asi 4 minúty. Vmiešame kapustu, 2 PL (30 ml) vody a ½ ČL (2,5 ml) soli. Prikryjeme a za občasného miešania dusíme, kým kapusta nezvädne a zľahka nezhnedne, 8 až 10 minút. Kapustovú zmes preložíme do kastróla k zemiakom a premiešame. Panvicu vytrieme papierovými utierkami.

4. V prázdnej panvici rozpustíme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 1⅓ PL (20 g) masla. Pridáme zemiakovo-kapustovú zmes a gumenou stierkou ju natlačíme do rovnomernej vrstvy. Opekáme bez miešania, kým spodok nie je dobre opečený, asi 7 minút.

5. Zmes obraciame po častiach veľkosti obracačky a zľahka ju znova natlačíme v panvici. Zvyšné 1⅓ PL (20 g) masla nalámeme na malé kúsky a rozložíme po okraji panvice. Obracanie opakujeme každých pár minút, kým zemiakovo-kapustová zmes nie je rovnomerne opečená, ešte 8 až 10 minút. Podávame.

4 medium scallions (43 g total), white and green parts thinly sliced and divided

1. In a large pot or Dutch oven, cover potatoes with water and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes.

2. While potatoes are cooking, in a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Once butter is melted, add white and light green scallion slices and garlic and cook, stirring often, until fragrant and translucent, about 1 minute. Add cabbage and cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage is tender, 6 to 8 minutes. Stir in milk and seaweed, if using, bring to a simmer, then remove from heat.

3. In a colander, drain potatoes, shaking off any excess water. Set a ricer or food mill over now-empty pot and pass potatoes through. Add milk and cabbage mixture, salt, pepper, and half of sliced green scallion tops; fold until just combined. If potatoes are too thick, fold in additional hot milk as needed for desired potato texture. Season with additional salt to taste, if needed. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with remaining scallion greens. Top with pats of butter and black pepper. Serve.

Pri ohrievaní pridávame vodu po 1 ČL (5 ml), kým nemá želanú hustotu, a potom ho prehrejeme v mikrovlnnej rúre. Vychladnutý ho môžeme zmraziť v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až na 3 mesiace. c.t: Marrowfat peas are fully matured peas dried on the vine, sold online and in specialty stores. Some come with a baking soda packet for soaking; use it with 1 tsp kosher salt if you like (half as much table salt by volume).

en.t: 1. In a large bowl, combine baking soda and 1 tsp (5 ml) salt. Add peas; add enough water to cover peas by 7.5 cm, and stir to combine. Cover with a plate, kitchen towel, or plastic wrap, and let sit at room temperature for at least 8 hours and up to 12 hours.

2. Using a fine-mesh sieve, drain and rinse peas. In a 3780 ml saucepan, combine peas and 590 ml water. Bring to a boil over high. 3. Uncover saucepan. Using the back of a spoon or a potato masher, mash peas until starting to become smooth. c.t: The puddings are best when the batter rests at least overnight, but they can be baked at once (go straight from step 1 to step 2). To make 12 instead of 8, scale up by 50%. With skim or low-fat milk, omit the water and use 200 g milk.

Yorkshirské pudingy sú najlepšie, keď cesto odpočíva aspoň cez noc, ale môžete ich upiecť aj hneď (z kroku 1 rovno na krok 2). Ak chcete 12 namiesto 8, zväčšite dávku o 50 %. S odstredeným alebo nízkotučným mliekom vynechajte vodu a použite 200 g mlieka.

en.t: 4 large eggs (200 g)
150 g all-purpose flour
175 g whole milk
2 g kosher salt (about 1/2 tsp)
25 g water (1 tbsp plus 2 tsp)
100 ml beef drippings, lard, shortening, or vegetable oil

1. Combine eggs, flour, milk, water, and salt in a medium bowl and whisk until a smooth batter is formed. Let batter rest at room temperature for at least 30 minutes. Alternatively, for best results, transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate batter overnight or for up to 3 days. Remove from refrigerator while you preheat the oven.

2. Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 230 °C (fan 210 °C). Divide drippings (or other fat) evenly between two 20 cm cast iron or oven-safe non-stick skillets, two 6-well popover tins, one 12-well standard muffin tin, or one 24-well mini muffin tin. Preheat in the oven until the fat is smoking hot, about 10 minutes.

3. Transfer the pans or tins to a heat-proof surface (such as an aluminum baking sheet on your stovetop), and divide the batter evenly between every well (or between the two pans if using pans). The wells should be filled between 1/2 and 3/4 of the way (if using pans, they should be filled about 1/4 of the way). Immediately return to oven. Bake until the yorkshire puddings have just about quadrupled in volume, are deep brown all over, crisp to the touch, and sound hollow when tapped. Smaller ones will take about 15 minutes, popover- or skillet-sized ones will take around 25 minutes.
4. Serve immediately, or cool completely, transfer to a zipper-lock freezer bag, and freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat in a hot toaster oven before serving.

1. V strednej mise metličkou vymiešame vajcia, múku, mlieko, vodu a soľ na hladké cesto. Cesto necháme aspoň 30 minút odpočívať pri izbovej teplote. Pre najlepší výsledok ho môžeme preliať do vzduchotesnej nádoby a nechať v chladničke cez noc alebo najviac 3 dni. Kým sa rúra rozohrieva, vyberieme ho z chladničky.

2. Rošt dáme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 230 °C (teplovzdušnú na 210 °C). Výpek (alebo iný tuk) rovnomerne rozdelíme do dvoch liatinových alebo nepriľnavých panvíc vhodných do rúry s priemerom 20 cm, do dvoch foriem na popovery so 6 jamkami, do jednej bežnej formy na muffiny s 12 jamkami alebo do jednej formy na mini muffiny s 24 jamkami. Zohrievame v rúre, kým tuk nie je rozpálený do dymu, asi 10 minút.

3. Panvice alebo formy preložíme na žiaruvzdorný povrch (napríklad hliníkový plech na sporáku) a cesto rovnomerne rozdelíme do všetkých jamiek (alebo do oboch panvíc). Jamky majú byť naplnené do ½ až ¾ (panvice asi do ¼). Hneď vrátime do rúry. Pečieme, kým yorkshirské pudingy nezväčšia objem takmer štvornásobne, nie sú dookola sýto hnedé, na dotyk chrumkavé a pri poklepaní neznejú duto. Menšie sa pečú asi 15 minút, veľké z foriem na popovery alebo z panvíc asi 25 minút.
4. Podávame ihneď, alebo ich necháme úplne vychladnúť, preložíme do uzatvárateľného mraziaceho vrecka a zmrazíme najviac na 3 mesiace. Pred podávaním ich prehrejeme v horúcej mini rúre.

time.en: 10 min | Cook: 90 min | Total: 100 min

en.v: Wok or nonstick saucepan, mandoline, rimmed baking sheet, fine-mesh strainer, colander, 23 × 33 cm baking dish

sk.v: Wok alebo nepriľnavá rajnica, mandolínové struhadlo, plech s okrajom, jemné sitko, cedník, zapekacia misa 23 × 33 cm

en.v: Fried shallots can be made up to one month in advance and stored in an airtight container. Mushroom sauce can be made up to four days in advance. Assembled casserole can be made and stored up to two days in the refrigerator. To complete, cover with foil and heat in a preheated 180 °C oven until hot, about 30 minutes. Uncover and cook until bubbly, about 10 minutes longer. Top with 235 ml additional fried shallots and serve.

sk.v: Vyprážanú šalotku môžeme pripraviť až mesiac vopred a uchovávať v uzatvárateľnej nádobe. Hubovú omáčku môžeme pripraviť až štyri dni vopred. Poskladané zapekané jedlo môžeme pripraviť a uchovávať v chladničke až dva dni. Na dokončenie ho prikryjeme alobalom a ohrejeme vo vyhriatej rúre pri 180 °C dohorúca, asi 30 minút. Odkryjeme a pečieme, kým nezačne bublať, ešte asi 10 minút. Posypeme ďalšími 235 ml vyprážanej šalotky a podávame.

en.t: 450 g shallots, peeled and sliced 0.5 cm thick on a mandoline
480 ml canola oil
Kosher salt
675 g white button mushrooms, rinsed and spun dry in a salad spinner
2 tsp (10 ml) soy sauce
2 tsp (10 ml) lemon juice from 1 lemon
480 ml low-sodium store-bought or homemade chicken stock
360 ml heavy cream
2 tbsp (30 g) butter
2 cloves garlic, finely minced or grated on a Microplane grater
30 g flour
Freshly ground black pepper
900 g green beans, ends trimmed, cut into 5 cm segments

1. Combine shallots and oil in a wok or medium nonstick saucepan. Shallots should barely stick out above level of oil. Place over high heat and cook, stirring frequently, until shallots are completely soft, about 12 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, line a rimmed baking sheet with 6 layers of paper towels. Continue to cook shallots, stirring constantly, until shallots are light golden brown, about 8 minutes.
3. Immediately strain through a fine-mesh strainer set in a heat-proof bowl or saucepan. Set shallot oil aside. You should have about 475 ml of fried shallots.

4. Transfer fried shallots to paper towels. Lift up one end of top paper towel and roll shallots off onto second. Blot with first towel to absorb excess oil. Repeat 4 more times, transferring shallots from one paper towel to the next, until only one paper towel remains. Season well with salt.
5. Allow shallots to cool completely, about 45 minutes. Once they've cooled, transfer to a sealed airtight container. Shallots can be made up to 1 month in advance.
6. Smash mushrooms under the bottom of a large skillet until broken into 0.6–1.5 cm pieces. Roughly chop into pieces approximately 0.3–0.5 cm in size. Set aside.
7. Combine soy sauce, lemon juice, chicken stock, and heavy cream in a 945 ml liquid measuring cup or medium bowl.

8. Add 2 tbsp (30 ml) reserved shallot oil (save remainder in an airtight container for another use) and butter to a 30 cm nonstick skillet. Heat over high heat until butter is melted and foaming subsides. Add mushrooms to skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is evaporated and mushrooms begin to sizzle, 6 to 10 minutes.

9. Reduce heat to medium-high. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, until light golden blond, 1 to 2 minutes. Whisking constantly, add stock and cream mixture.
10. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook until mixture achieves a texture between pancake batter and heavy cream, about 5 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

11. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat oven to 180 °C (fan 160 °C). Bring 3800 ml water and 48 g kosher salt to a boil over high heat. Fill a large bowl with ice cubes and 1900 ml water.

12. Add green beans to water and boil until tender but still bright green, about 5 minutes. Drain through a colander set over the sink and immediately transfer to ice water until completely cooled. Drain green beans and set aside.

13. Combine green beans, mushroom sauce, and 235 ml fried shallots. Transfer to a 23 × 33 cm rectangular baking dish or a 25 × 36 cm oval baking dish. Bake until hot and bubbly, 15 to 20 minutes. Top with the remaining 235 ml fried shallots and serve.
frying oil unchanged (needed for depth); drain well on paper — own adjustment
lactose-free cooking cream (10–15%) instead of cream (lower fat, fine in savoury sauces) — own adjustment
lactose-free butter or ghee; amount reduced to 70% — own adjustment

1. Do woku alebo stredného nepriľnavého kastróla dáme šalotku a olej. Šalotka má len tesne vytŕčať nad hladinu oleja. Postavíme na silný oheň a za častého miešania zohrievame, kým šalotka nie je úplne mäkká, asi 12 minút.
2. Medzitým plech s okrajom vystelieme 6 vrstvami papierových utierok. Šalotku za stáleho miešania vyprážame ďalej, kým nie je svetlozlatohnedá, asi 8 minút.
3. Hneď ju precedíme cez jemné sitko postavené na žiaruvzdornej mise alebo v kastróli. Šalotkový olej odložíme. Mali by sme mať asi 475 ml vyprážanej šalotky.

4. Vyprážanú šalotku preložíme na papierové utierky. Nadvihneme jeden koniec vrchnej utierky a šalotku z nej zosypeme na druhú. Prvou utierkou ju poťapkáme, aby sa odsal prebytočný olej. Zopakujeme ešte 4-krát a šalotku presýpame z utierky na utierku, kým nezostane len jedna. Dobre osolíme.
5. Šalotku necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 45 minút. Po vychladnutí ju preložíme do vzduchotesnej nádoby. Šalotku môžeme pripraviť až mesiac vopred.
6. Huby rozdrvíme dnom veľkej panvice na kúsky veľké 0,6 – 1,5 cm. Nahrubo ich nasekáme na kúsky veľké asi 0,3 – 0,5 cm. Odložíme.
7. V odmerke s objemom 945 ml alebo v strednej mise zmiešame sójovú omáčku, citrónovú šťavu, kurací vývar a smotanu na šľahanie.

8. Do nepriľnavej panvice s priemerom 30 cm dáme 2 PL (30 ml) odloženého šalotkového oleja (zvyšok uschováme vo vzduchotesnej nádobe na iné použitie) a maslo. Zohrejeme na silnom ohni, kým sa maslo nerozpustí a neprestane peniť. Pridáme huby a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým sa tekutina neodparí a huby nezačnú syčať, 6 až 10 minút.

9. Oheň stlmíme na stredne silný až silný. Pridáme cesnak a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nezavonia, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme múku a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým nie je svetlozlatistá, 1 až 2 minúty. Za stáleho šľahania prilejeme zmes vývaru a smotany.
10. Privedieme do varu, stlmíme na mierny var a varíme, kým zmes nemá konzistenciu medzi cestom na palacinky a hustou smotanou, asi 5 minút. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme.

11. Rošt dáme do spodnej tretiny rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu 3800 ml vody a 48 g hrubej soli. Veľkú misu naplníme kockami ľadu a 1900 ml vody.

12. Fazuľku vložíme do vriacej vody a varíme, kým nie je mäkká, ale stále jasnozelená, asi 5 minút. Scedíme v cedníku v dreze a hneď preložíme do ľadovej vody, kým úplne nevychladne. Fazuľku scedíme a odložíme.

13. Zmiešame fazuľku, hubovú omáčku a 235 ml vyprážanej šalotky. Preložíme do obdĺžnikovej zapekacej misy 23 × 33 cm alebo oválnej zapekacej misy 25 × 36 cm. Pečieme, kým nie je horúca a nebublá, 15 až 20 minút. Navrch dáme zvyšných 235 ml vyprážanej šalotky a podávame.

en.t: 1 large lemon
4 medium artichokes (225–285 g each)
56 g fresh bread crumbs
4 medium cloves garlic, minced or pressed through a garlic press
59 ml minced fresh parsley leaves, stems reserved
59 ml minced fresh mint
120 ml extra-virgin olive oil
Salt
1 medium onion, cut crosswise into 1.5 cm-thick slices and separated into rings
Ground black pepper

1. Grate the zest from the lemon and reserve. Squeeze 1 tsp (5 ml) juice from the lemon and reserve. Squeeze the remaining lemon juice into a large mixing bowl halfway filled with water and add the spent lemon halves. Working with one artichoke at a time, clean the artichokes and immediately add them to the bowl of water to prevent discoloration.

2. Once the artichokes are all clean, combine the lemon zest, bread crumbs, garlic, minced parsley leaves, mint, olive oil, 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Using a small spoon, divide the filling equally among the artichokes, placing it in the center of the artichoke where the choke was.

3. Spread the onion rings evenly over the bottom of a Dutch oven and sprinkle them with the reserved parsley stems and 1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) salt. Position the artichokes evenly around the pan, with the stems facing downward at an angle and set into the onion rings. Fill the pan with enough cold water so that the stems are three-quarters submerged. Cover the pot and bring the water to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes. Use tongs to rotate the artichokes so that the side pointing down toward the water faces away from the water. Continue cooking until a knife tip easily punctures and pulls cleanly from the heart, about 15 minutes longer.

4. Carefully remove the artichokes from the pot and transfer them to a large plate. Strain the braising liquid through a fine-mesh strainer and return the liquid to the pot. Over high heat, briskly cook the liquid until it reduces to 120 ml, about 20 minutes. Pour the thickened liquid into a serving dish and stir in the reserved 1 tsp (5 ml) lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Pass the artichokes and the sauce separately at the table; use the sauce for dipping.

1. Z citróna nastrúhame kôru a odložíme. Vytlačíme z neho 1 ČL (5 ml) šťavy a odložíme. Zvyšnú šťavu vytlačíme do veľkej misy do polovice naplnenej vodou a pridáme aj vytlačené polovice citróna. Artičoky čistíme po jednom a každú hneď vložíme do misy s vodou, aby nestmavla.

2. Keď sú všetky artičoky očistené, v malej miske zmiešame citrónovú kôru, strúhanku, cesnak, nadrobno nasekané lístky petržlenovej vňate, mätu, olivový olej, ½ ČL (2,5 ml) soli a korenie. Malou lyžičkou plnku rovnomerne rozdelíme do artičok – vložíme ju do stredu, kde bolo chlpaté srdiečko.

Artičoky rozostavíme rovnomerne po hrnci stonkami nadol, šikmo zapichnutými do cibuľových koliesok. Hrniec naplníme studenou vodou tak, aby boli stonky z troch štvrtín ponorené. Hrniec prikryjeme a vodu na stredne silnom až silnom ohni privedieme do varu. Oheň stlmíme na stredne slabý a varíme 15 minút. Kliešťami artičoky pootočíme tak, aby strana, ktorá smerovala k vode, smerovala od nej. Varíme ďalej, kým špička noža ľahko neprenikne do srdca a hladko z neho nevykĺzne, ešte asi 15 minút.

Zhustnutú tekutinu nalejeme do servírovacej misky a vmiešame odloženú 1 ČL (5 ml) citrónovej šťavy. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Artičoky a omáčku podávame pri stole zvlášť; omáčka slúži na namáčanie.

1. Fill a large bowl with water; halve and squeeze 2 lemons into it. Trim artichokes following Roman-Jewish artichoke guidelines shown here: Remove tough dark green outer leaves to expose more tender light-green leaves within, then, using a paring knife, cut off top half of each leaf and trim base and stem. Trimmed artichokes will look like a closed rosebud. Transfer the peeled artichokes to the bowl of lemon water as you work, covering them with a clean kitchen towel to keep them completely submerged.

2. In a large saucepan, heat 5–7.5 cm of oil to 130 °C. Add artichokes (they should produce a steady but non-violent stream of bubbles) and cook until tender (you should be able to pierce their hearts easily with a fork), adjusting heat to maintain a steady bubble, about 10 minutes for baby artichokes and 15 minutes for larger ones. Turn larger artichokes frequently for even cooking.

3. Using a slotted spoon or spider, transfer artichokes to a paper towel-lined plate. Let stand until cool enough to handle. Using your hands, gently pull open each artichoke "bud" so that it resembles an open flower. If using large artichokes, remove and discard the hair "choke" in the center of the artichoke. Increase oil temperature to 177 °C.

4. Fry artichokes until browned and crisp, 2 to 5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon or spider, transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Season immediately with salt. Transfer to plates and serve right away with wedges of remaining lemon.

1. Veľkú misu naplníme vodou; vytlačíme do nej šťavu z 2 rozpolených citrónov. Artičoky očistíme podľa rímsko-židovského spôsobu: odstránime tuhé tmavozelené vonkajšie listy, aby sa odkryli mäkšie svetlozelené listy vo vnútri, potom malým nožom odrežeme hornú polovicu každého listu a zarovnáme spodok aj stonku. Očistené artičoky vyzerajú ako zatvorené ružové puky. Očistené artičoky postupne vkladáme do misy s citrónovou vodou a prikryjeme ich čistou kuchynskou utierkou, aby boli úplne ponorené.

Pridáme artičoky (majú vytvárať rovnomerný, ale nie prudký prúd bubliniek) a vyprážame, kým nie sú mäkké (srdce musíme ľahko prepichnúť vidličkou); plameň upravujeme, aby olej rovnomerne bublal, asi 10 minút pri malých artičokách a 15 minút pri väčších. 1. Working in batches stack a few stemmed collard leaves on a cutting board, placing the larger leaves at the bottom. Roll the leaves tightly and slice them into thin strips, approximately 0.5 cm wide. (Make sure they are not too thin, as they may clump together during cooking.)
2. In a large skillet or sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add sliced onion and cook until softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add tomatoes and ginger and season lightly with salt. Cook, stirring often, until tomatoes have released most of their water, about 5 minutes.

4. Add collards to the pan and season with salt. Cook, lowering the heat as needed to avoid scorching, until collards have softened but retain a vibrant green color and slightly crunchy texture, 8 to 10 minutes. Or, if desired, cook until collards are fully softened and have darkened in color, 15 to 25 minutes total. Season with salt to taste. Serve.

c.t: Canned whole tomatoes are often best, but a purée of good cooked fresh tomatoes works; peeled, seeded, diced fresh tomatoes hold their shape more and taste milder. The herbs are optional; oregano, marjoram and savory also work. To speed up steps 2 to 5, cook the vegetables in several skillets at once.

Sterilizované celé paradajky bývajú najlepšie, ale poslúži aj pyré z dobrých uvarených čerstvých; olúpané, nakrájané čerstvé paradajky bez semienok si viac zachovajú tvar a chutia jemnejšie. Bylinky sú nepovinné; hodí sa aj oregano, majorán a saturejka. Kroky 2 až 5 urýchlite, ak zeleninu opečiete vo viacerých panviciach naraz.

en.t: 710 ml 0.5 cm diced summer squash, such as zucchini and yellow squash (about 4 small or 2 medium squash)
710 ml 0.5 cm diced Italian eggplant (about 1 medium eggplant)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
175 ml extra-virgin olive oil, divided, plus more as needed
710 ml 0.5 cm diced yellow onion (about 3 medium onions)
6 medium cloves garlic, minced (about 2 tbsp (30 ml))
710 ml 0.5 cm diced red and yellow bell pepper (about 4 large peppers)
475 ml pureed canned whole tomatoes, with their juices, from 1 (795 g) can
1 bouquet garni (herb bundle), made from fresh herbs such as thyme, parsley, and basil, tied together with butcher's twine
Chopped fresh parsley leaves and tender stems, for garnish (optional)

1. Place summer squash in a wire mesh strainer set over a bowl; place eggplant in a second wire mesh strainer and set over a second bowl. Toss both with a liberal amount of kosher salt and let stand to drain at least 15 minutes and up to 1 hour. Discard any liquid that collects in the bowls.

2. In a large skillet, heat 3 tbsp (44 ml) olive oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add onion and garlic, season with salt, and cook, stirring, until softened, about 6 minutes. Scrape onion and garlic onto a rimmed baking sheet and spread in an even layer to cool for 3 minutes. Transfer onion and garlic to a large pot.

3. Meanwhile, add 3 more tbsp olive oil to skillet and heat over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add bell pepper, season with salt, and cook, stirring, until softened, about 7 minutes. Scrape bell pepper onto the rimmed baking sheet in an even layer to cool for 3 minutes. Transfer bell pepper to pot with onion.

4. Add 3 more tbsp olive oil to skillet and heat over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add summer squash and cook, stirring, until softened, about 4 minutes. Scrape onto rimmed baking sheet in an even layer to cool for 3 minutes. Transfer to pot with onion and bell pepper.

5. Add remaining 3 tbsp (44 ml) olive oil to skillet and heat over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add eggplant and cook, stirring, until softened, about 4 minutes; add more olive oil as needed if skillet dries out while cooking eggplant. Scrape eggplant into pot with other vegetables and stir to combine.

6. Set pot of vegetables over medium-high heat and stir in tomato purée and herb bundle; heat until ratatouille is gently bubbling, then lower heat to medium and cook, stirring, until tomato purée coats vegetables in a thick sauce, about 15 minutes. Discard herb bundle. Season with salt, stir in chopped parsley (if using), and drizzle with a small amount of fresh extra-virgin olive oil. Serve right away, or chill and serve either reheated, slightly chilled, or at room temperature.

1. Letnú tekvicu (cuketu) dáme do drôteného sitka postaveného nad misou; baklažán do druhého sitka nad druhou misou. Oboje bohato posypeme hrubou soľou a necháme odkvapkať aspoň 15 minút a najviac 1 hodinu. Tekutinu, ktorá sa nazbiera v miskách, vylejeme.

2. Vo veľkej panvici zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 2¼ PL (33 ml) olivového oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a cesnak, osolíme a za miešania dusíme, kým nezmäknú, asi 6 minút. Cibuľu s cesnakom zoškrabeme na plech s okrajom, rozotrieme v rovnomernej vrstve a necháme 3 minúty chladnúť. Preložíme do veľkého hrnca.

3. Medzitým do panvice pridáme ďalšie 3 PL olivového oleja a zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme papriku, osolíme a za miešania dusíme, kým nezmäkne, asi 7 minút. Papriku zoškrabeme na plech s okrajom v rovnomernej vrstve a necháme 3 minúty chladnúť. Preložíme do hrnca k cibuli.

4. Do panvice pridáme ďalšie 3 PL olivového oleja a zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme letnú tekvicu a za miešania dusíme, kým nezmäkne, asi 4 minúty. Zoškrabeme na plech s okrajom v rovnomernej vrstve a necháme 3 minúty chladnúť. Preložíme do hrnca k cibuli a paprike.

5. Do panvice pridáme zvyšné 2¼ PL (33 ml) olivového oleja a zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme baklažán a za miešania dusíme, kým nezmäkne, asi 4 minúty; ak panvica počas pečenia vyschne, podľa potreby pridáme olivový olej. Baklažán zoškrabeme do hrnca k ostatnej zelenine a premiešame.

6. Hrniec so zeleninou postavíme na stredne silný až silný oheň a vmiešame paradajkové pyré a zväzok byliniek; zohrievame, kým ratatouille jemne nebublá, potom oheň stlmíme na stredný a za miešania dusíme, kým paradajkové pyré neobalí zeleninu hustou omáčkou, asi 15 minút. Zväzok byliniek vyhodíme. Osolíme, vmiešame nasekanú petržlenovú vňať (ak ju používame) a pokvapkáme trochou čerstvého extra panenského olivového oleja. Podávame hneď, alebo vychladené a potom prehriate, mierne chladné alebo pri izbovej teplote.

en.t: 2 large eggplants
1 tsp (3 g) Kosher salt
120 ml olive oil
3 tbsp (44 ml) balsamic vinegar
1 large clove garlic, grated
Freshly cracked black pepper
355 ml marinara sauce, divided
255 g fresh mozzarella, torn in small chunks
4 tbsp (59 ml) finely grated Parmigiano Reggiano
4 tsp (20 ml) pesto sauce or pistou
1. Slice the eggplant into 1.5 cm rounds. Toss the eggplant with the salt in a large colander, and allow to sit and drain in the sink for 30 minutes.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, and pepper. Without rinsing the eggplant, toss them with the vinaigrette, and let marinate for 15 minutes.

3. Preheat the broiler. Arrange the slices in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet (you may need to do this in batches). Broil until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Flip the eggplant slices over with a spatula and brown the other side. (The time will vary depending on the strength of your broiler.)

4. Heat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Place 2 tbsp (30 ml) of marinara sauce in the bottom of each of 4 small au gratin dishes. Divide the eggplant slices among the 4 dishes. Top each dish with 59 ml of marinara sauce. Then divide the mozzarella pieces among the 4 dishes, and finally the Parmigiano Reggiano. Place the gratin dishes on a rimmed baking sheet to catch any spills, and bake for 30 minutes until the marinara sauce is bubbling, and the cheese is melted. Let the tians rest for 10 minutes. Drizzle with 1 tsp (5 ml) of pesto per tian, and serve.

1. Baklažán nakrájame na kolieska hrubé 1,5 cm. Vo veľkom cedníku ho premiešame so soľou a necháme 30 minút odkvapkať v dreze.
2. Vo veľkej mise metličkou zmiešame olivový olej, balzamikový ocot, cesnak a korenie. Baklažán neoplachujeme, premiešame ho s vinaigrettom a necháme 15 minút marinovať.

c.t: Serve on toasted baguette slices or with grilled meat or fish; adjust the vinegar to the tomatoes and the pairing. Undyed paper towels can replace coffee filters for microwaving the eggplant; remove the plate at once so the steam escapes. Tomato juice can replace V8. Caponata is best made ahead and keeps in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Podávajte na opečených plátkoch bagety alebo ku grilovanému mäsu či rybe; množstvo octu prispôsobte paradajkám a jedlu. Kávové filtre na ohrievanie baklažánu v mikrovlnke môžete nahradiť nefarbenými papierovými utierkami; tanier hneď vyberte, aby para unikla. V8 môžete nahradiť paradajkovou šťavou. Caponata je najlepšia pripravená vopred a vo vzduchotesnej nádobe vydrží v chladničke najviac 1 týždeň.

en.t: 1 eggplant (about 680 g), cut into 1.5 cm cubes (about 1660 ml)
3/4 tsp (2 g) kosher salt
175 ml vegetable juice, preferably V8
59 ml red wine vinegar, plus extra for seasoning
2 tbsp (24 g) light brown sugar
59 ml minced fresh parsley leaves
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) minced anchovy fillets (2 to 3 fillets)
225 g ripe tomatoes (2 medium), cored, seeded, and cut into 1.5 cm dice (about 235 ml)
37 g raisins
2 tbsp (30 ml) minced black olives
2 tbsp (30 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
1 celery rib, cut into 0.5 cm dice (about 120 ml)
1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 0.5 cm dice (about 120 ml)
1 onion, diced fine (about 120 ml)
36 g pine nuts, toasted

1. Toss eggplant and salt together in medium bowl. Line entire surface of large microwave-safe plate with double layer of coffee filters and lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray. Spread eggplant in even layer over coffee filters. Microwave on high power until eggplant is dry and shriveled to one-third of its size, 8 to 15 minutes (eggplant should not brown). (If microwave has no turntable, rotate plate after 5 minutes.) Remove eggplant from microwave and immediately transfer to paper towel-lined plate.
2. Meanwhile, whisk vegetable juice, vinegar, brown sugar, parsley, and anchovies together in medium bowl. Stir in tomatoes, raisins, and olives.

3. Heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until edges are browned, 4 to 8 minutes, adding 1 tsp (5 ml) oil if pan appears dry. Transfer to bowl and set aside.

4. Add remaining 2 tsp (10 ml) oil to now-empty skillet and heat until shimmering. Add celery and red pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and edges are spotty brown, 2 to 4 minutes. Add onion and continue to cook until vegetables are browned, about 4 minutes longer.

5. Reduce heat to medium-low; stir in eggplant and vegetable juice mixture. Bring to simmer and cook until vegetable juice is thickened and coats vegetables, 4 to 7 minutes. Transfer to serving bowl and cool to room temperature. Taste and season with up to 1 tsp (5 ml) additional vinegar. Sprinkle with pine nuts before serving.

Spread eggplant in even layer over coffee filters. Microwave on high power until eggplant is dry and shriveled to one-third of its size, 8 to 15 minutes (eggplant should not brown). (If microwave has no turntable, rotate plate after 5 minutes.) Remove eggplant from microwave and immediately transfer to paper towel-lined plate.
2. Meanwhile, whisk vegetable juice, vinegar, brown sugar, parsley, and anchovies together in medium bowl. Stir in tomatoes, raisins, and olives.

3. Heat 1¾ tsp (9 ml) oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until edges are browned, 4 to 8 minutes, adding ⅔ tsp (3 ml) oil if pan appears dry. Transfer to bowl and set aside.

4. Add remaining 1¼ tsp (6 ml) oil to now-empty skillet and heat until shimmering. Add celery and red pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and edges are spotty brown, 2 to 4 minutes. Add onion and continue to cook until vegetables are browned, about 4 minutes longer.

5. Reduce heat to medium-low; stir in eggplant and vegetable juice mixture. Bring to simmer and cook until vegetable juice is thickened and coats vegetables, 4 to 7 minutes. 1. V strednej mise premiešame baklažán so soľou. Celý povrch veľkého taniera vhodného do mikrovlnnej rúry vystelieme dvojitou vrstvou kávových filtrov a zľahka postriekame olejom v spreji. Baklažán rozložíme v rovnomernej vrstve na filtre. V mikrovlnnej rúre na plný výkon ohrievame, kým baklažán nie je suchý a nescvrkne sa na tretinu, 8 až 15 minút (baklažán nemá zhnednúť). (Ak mikrovlnná rúra nemá otočný tanier, po 5 minútach tanier otočíme.) Baklažán vyberieme a hneď preložíme na tanier vystlaný papierovými utierkami.
2. Medzitým v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame zeleninovú šťavu, ocot, hnedý cukor, petržlenovú vňať a ančovičky. Vmiešame paradajky, hrozienka a olivy.

3. V nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme baklažán a za občasného miešania opekáme, kým okraje nezhnednú, 4 až 8 minút; ak sa panvica zdá suchá, pridáme ⅔ ČL (3 ml) oleja. Preložíme do misy a odložíme.

4. Do prázdnej panvice pridáme zvyšné 1¼ ČL (6 ml) oleja a zohrejeme, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme stopkový zeler a červenú papriku; za občasného miešania opekáme, kým nezmäknú a okraje nie sú miestami hnedé, 2 až 4 minúty. Pridáme cibuľu a opekáme ďalej, kým zelenina nezhnedne, ešte asi 4 minúty.

5. Oheň stlmíme na stredne slabý; vmiešame baklažán a zmes so zeleninovou šťavou. Privedieme do mierneho varu a varíme, kým zeleninová šťava nezhustne a neobalí zeleninu, 4 až 7 minút. Preložíme do servírovacej misy a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu. Ochutnáme a dochutíme najviac 1 ČL (5 ml) ďalšieho octu. Pred podávaním posypeme píniovými orieškami.

cat.en: Brown the aubergine well before combining it with the sweet-and-sour sauce, and let the caponata rest; it tastes even better the next day.
cat.sk: Baklažán poriadne opečte skôr, ako ho spojíte so sladkokyslou omáčkou, a caponatu nechajte odstáť; na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.

src: Serious Eats — Daniel Gritzer — "Melanzane alla Parmigiana (Italian-Style Eggplant Parmesan) Recipe"

time.en: 5 min | Cook: 50 min | Total: 85 min

en.v: 1420 ml baking dish, 25 cm cast iron skillet, half sheet pan

sk.v: Zapekacia misa 1420 ml, liatinová panvica 25 cm, polovičný plech (half-sheet)

c.t: The tomato sauce must not be thin: simmer it to about the consistency of thin applesauce. A simple one: lightly brown 1 garlic clove in 2 tbsp olive oil, add 1 can (425 g) puréed whole tomatoes or passata and simmer with basil or oregano; season and discard the garlic and herbs.

Paradajková omáčka nesmie byť riedka: varte ju, kým nemá hustotu asi ako riedke jablkové pyré. Jednoduchá verzia: na 2 PL olivového oleja zľahka opečte 1 strúčik cesnaku, pridajte 1 plechovku (425 g) rozmixovaných celých paradajok alebo passatu a povarte s bazalkou alebo oreganom; osoľte a cesnak s bylinkami vyberte.

en.t: Olive oil, vegetable oil, or a combination, for frying
900 g eggplant, sliced 0.5 cm thick
Kosher salt
360 ml tomato sauce
340 g shredded fresh mozzarella
Torn fresh oregano leaves, from about 4 sprigs
1. Set wire racks in two rimmed baking sheets. Arrange eggplant slices on racks and sprinkle lightly on both sides with salt. Let stand 20 minutes, then blot dry with towels.

2. Preheat oven to 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Fill a large cast iron skillet with 1.5 cm oil and heat over high heat until shimmering. Working in 3 to 4 batches, fry eggplant slices, turning, until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer fried eggplant to a paper towel–lined half sheet pan to drain well, replacing paper towels as needed. Season lightly with salt. Repeat with remaining eggplant, topping up oil as needed.

3. In a 1420 ml baking dish, arrange a layer of eggplant slices. Top with a thin layer of tomato sauce, followed by shredded mozzarella and oregano or basil leaves. Continue layering eggplant, sauce, cheese, and herbs to fill baking dish. Do not add oregano or basil to the top layer.
4. Bake eggplant Parmesan until bubbling and browned on top, 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes to reabsorb juices. Sprinkle with oregano or basil leaves and serve.

lactose-free mozzarella (light where melting is not essential) instead of fresh/soft cheese — own adjustment

2. Preheat oven to 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Fill a large cast iron skillet with 1.5 cm oil and heat over high heat until shimmering. 1. Do dvoch plechov s okrajom vložíme mriežky. Plátky baklažánu rozložíme na mriežky a z oboch strán ich zľahka osolíme. Necháme 20 minút postáť, potom ich osušíme utierkami.

2. Rúru rozohrejeme na 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C). Do veľkej liatinovej panvice nalejeme olej do výšky 1,5 cm a na silnom ohni ho zohrejeme, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. V 3 až 4 dávkach vyprážame plátky baklažánu a obraciame ich, kým nie sú z oboch strán opečené, asi 5 minút. Vyprážaný baklažán preložíme na polovičný plech vystlaný papierovými utierkami, aby dobre odkvapkal; utierky podľa potreby vymieňame. Zľahka osolíme. Rovnako vypražíme zvyšný baklažán a podľa potreby dolievame olej.

3. Do zapekacej misy s objemom 1420 ml uložíme vrstvu plátkov baklažánu. Navrch dáme tenkú vrstvu paradajkovej omáčky, potom nastrúhanú mozzarellu a lístky oregana alebo bazalky. Vo vrstvení baklažánu, omáčky, syra a byliniek pokračujeme, kým misa nie je plná. Na vrchnú vrstvu oregano ani bazalku nedávame.
4. Parmigianu pečieme, kým nebublá a navrchu nie je opečená, 25 až 30 minút. Necháme 10 minút postáť, aby sa šťava znova vsiakla. Posypeme lístkami oregana alebo bazalky a podávame.

en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

c.t: Oil: 1–2 tbsp oil, sprayed or brushed on (instead of the frying oil)
Air fryer: 200 °C, 8–10 min, turning halfway (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches)
Steps:
1. Salt and blot the eggplant slices as in step 1, then brush both sides lightly with oil.
2. Air-fry in batches in a single layer until browned on both sides, 8–10 minutes, turning halfway.
3. Layer and bake as in steps 3–4.

en.v: oven 220 °C (fan 200 °C) on a rack over a lined tray, about 1.5–2× the air-fryer time, turning halfway.

sk.v: teplovzdušná fritéza (vlastná úprava): namiesto vyprážania podľa postupu nižšie môžeme jedlo pripraviť v teplovzdušnej fritéze.

c.t: Olej: 1–2 PL oleja, nastriekaného alebo natretého štetcom (namiesto oleja na vyprážanie)
Teplovzdušná fritéza: 200 °C, 8–10 min, v polovici obrátiť (predhriať 3 min; kôš neprepĺňať — pripravovať po dávkach)
Postup:
1. Plátky baklažánu osolíme a osušíme podľa kroku 1, potom ich z oboch strán zľahka potrieme olejom.
2. Pečieme po dávkach v jednej vrstve, kým nie sú z oboch strán opečené, 8–10 minút; v polovici ich obrátime.
3. Navrstvíme a zapečieme podľa krokov 3–4.

src: America's Test Kitchen — "Stuffed Eggplant (Imam Bayildi)"

servT.en: Serves 4 as an main course, or 8 as a side dish
servT.sk: 4 porcie ako hlavné jedlo alebo 8 porcií ako príloha

time.en: not given | Cook: not given | Total: not given

en.t: 4 Italian eggplant (about 285 g each), halved lengthwise
59 ml olive oil
Salt and ground black pepper
1 medium onion, minced
3 medium garlic cloves, minced or pressed through a garlic press (about 1 tbsp (15 ml))
2 tsp (10 ml) minced fresh oregano leaves, or 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) dried
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground cinnamon
1/8 tsp (0.6 ml) cayenne pepper
455 g plum tomatoes (3 to 4 tomatoes), cored, seeded, and chopped medium
57 g Pecorino Romano, grated (about 235 ml)
36 g pine nuts, toasted
1 tbsp (15 ml) red wine vinegar
2 tbsp (30 ml) minced fresh parsley leaves
1. Adjust two oven racks to the upper-middle and lowest positions, place a rimmed baking sheet on the lowest rack, and heat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C).

2. Brush the cut sides of the eggplant with 2 tbsp (30 ml) of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Set the eggplant cut side down on the hot baking sheet and, using oven mitts, carefully cover with foil. Roast until the eggplant is golden brown and tender, 50 to 55 minutes. Carefully transfer the eggplant to a paper towel–lined baking sheet and let drain. Do not turn off the oven.

3. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) oil in a 30 cm skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add the onion and 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) salt and cook until softened and browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in the garlic, oregano, cinnamon, and cayenne and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in the tomatoes, 175 ml of the cheese, nuts, and vinegar and cook until warmed through, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper to taste and set aside.

4. Return the roasted eggplant cut side up to the rimmed baking sheet (or use a large casserole dish). Using two forks, gently push the flesh to the sides of each eggplant half to make room for the filling. Mound about 59 ml of the filling into each eggplant. (At this point, the eggplants can be covered and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.)

5. Sprinkle with the remaining 59 ml cheese and bake on the upper-middle rack until the cheese is melted, 5 to 10 minutes. (If refrigerated, increase the baking time to 8 to 12 minutes.) Sprinkle with the parsley and serve warm or at room temperature.

c.t: 1. Adjust two oven racks to the upper-middle and lowest positions, place a rimmed baking sheet on the lowest rack, and heat the oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C).

2. Brush the cut sides of the eggplant with 1¼ tbsp (18 ml) of the oil and season with salt and pepper. Set the eggplant cut side down on the hot baking sheet and, using oven mitts, carefully cover with foil. Roast until the eggplant is golden brown and tender, 50 to 55 minutes. Carefully transfer the eggplant to a paper towel–lined baking sheet and let drain. Do not turn off the oven.

3. Meanwhile, heat the remaining 1¼ tbsp (18 ml) oil in a 30 cm skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add the onion and 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) salt and cook until softened and browned, about 10 minutes. Stir in the garlic, oregano, cinnamon, and cayenne and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in the tomatoes, 175 ml of the cheese, nuts, and vinegar and cook until warmed through, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper to taste and set aside.

4. Return the roasted eggplant cut side up to the rimmed baking sheet (or use a large casserole dish). Using two forks, gently push the flesh to the sides of each eggplant half to make room for the filling. Mound about 59 ml of the filling into each eggplant. (At this point, the eggplants can be covered and refrigerated for up to 24 hours.)

5. Sprinkle with the remaining 59 ml cheese and bake on the upper-middle rack until the cheese is melted, 5 to 10 minutes. (If refrigerated, increase the baking time to 8 to 12 minutes.) Sprinkle with the parsley and serve warm or at room temperature.
1. Dva rošty dáme do hornej tretiny a do najnižšej polohy rúry, na najnižší rošt položíme plech s okrajom a rúru rozohrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C).

2. Rezné plochy baklažánu potrieme 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja a osolíme a okoreníme. Baklažán položíme reznou stranou nadol na horúci plech a v chňapkách ho opatrne prikryjeme alobalom. Pečieme, kým baklažán nie je zlatohnedý a mäkký, 50 až 55 minút. Baklažán opatrne preložíme na plech vystlaný papierovými utierkami a necháme odkvapkať. Rúru nevypíname.

3. Medzitým v panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na strednom ohni zvyšné 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne lesknúť. Pridáme cibuľu a ½ ČL (2,5 ml) soli a dusíme, kým nezmäkne a nezhnedne, asi 10 minút. Vmiešame cesnak, oregano, škoricu a kajenské korenie a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Vmiešame paradajky, 175 ml syra, orechy a ocot a zohrievame, kým sa neprehrejú, asi 1 minútu. Podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme a odložíme.

4. Upečený baklažán vrátime reznou stranou nahor na plech s okrajom (alebo do veľkej zapekacej misy). Dvoma vidličkami jemne odtlačíme dužinu ku krajom každej polovice, aby vzniklo miesto na plnku. Do každého baklažánu navŕšime asi 59 ml plnky. (V tejto fáze môžeme baklažány prikryť a nechať v chladničke najviac 24 hodín.)

5. Posypeme zvyšnými 59 ml syra a pečieme na hornom rošte, kým sa syr neroztopí, 5 až 10 minút. (Ak boli v chladničke, pečieme 8 až 12 minút.) Posypeme petržlenovou vňaťou a podávame teplé alebo pri izbovej teplote.

1. Cut the aubergines lengthways into 3 thick slices, then cut these into evenly sized batons. Sprinkle them with salt, mix well and leave in a colander for at least 30 minutes to drain.

2. In a wok, heat the oil for deep-frying to 180 °C. Add the aubergines in batches and deep-fry for three to four minutes until slightly golden on the outside and soft and buttery within. Remove and drain on kitchen paper.

3. Drain off the deep-frying oil, rinse the wok if necessary, then return it to a medium flame. When the wok is hot again, add three tbsp of oil. Add the chilli bean paste and stir fry until the oil is red and fragrant, then add the ginger and garlic and continue to stir fry until you can smell their aromas. Take care not to burn these seasonings; remove the wok from the heat for a few seconds if necessary to control the temperature (you want a gentle, coaxing sizzle, not a scorching heat). Add the stock and sugar and mix well. Season with salt to taste if necessary.

4. Add the fried aubergines to the sauce and let them simmer gently for about a minute to absorb some of the flavours. Then stir the potato flour mixture, pour it over the aubergines and stir in gently to thicken the sauce. Add the vinegar and spring onions and stir a few times, then serve.

1. Baklažány pozdĺžne nakrájame na 3 hrubé plátky a tie potom na rovnako veľké hranolčeky. Posypeme ich soľou, dobre premiešame a necháme v cedníku aspoň 30 minút odkvapkať.

2. Vo woku zohrejeme olej na fritovanie na 180 °C. Baklažány po dávkach fritujeme 3 až 4 minúty, kým nie sú zvonka mierne zlatisté a vnútri mäkké a maslové. Vyberieme a necháme odkvapkať na kuchynskom papieri.

3. Olej na fritovanie zlejeme, wok podľa potreby opláchneme a vrátime ho na stredný plameň. Keď je wok znova horúci, pridáme 3 PL oleja. Pridáme čili fazuľovú pastu a za miešania opekáme, kým olej nie je červený a voňavý, potom pridáme zázvor a cesnak a opekáme ďalej, kým necítiť ich vôňu. Dávame pozor, aby sa koreniny nepripálili; ak treba, wok na pár sekúnd stiahneme z ohňa, aby sme udržali teplotu (chceme jemné, pozvoľné syčanie, nie spaľujúcu horúčavu). Prilejeme vývar a pridáme cukor a dobre premiešame. Ak treba, podľa chuti osolíme.

4. Vyprážané baklažány pridáme do omáčky a necháme ich asi minútu jemne povariť, aby nasali chute. Potom premiešame zmes zemiakového škrobu s vodou, nalejeme ju na baklažány a jemne vmiešame, aby omáčka zhustla. Pridáme ocot a jarnú cibuľku, niekoľkokrát premiešame a podávame.

cat.en: Fry the aubergine until soft and golden before adding the sauce; undercooked aubergine stays spongy and won't absorb the flavours.
